original_test_intent: Read one explicitly authorized ManagerAccount resource on the intended BMC, validate its resource identity and approved non-secret status/role fields, and preserve redacted evidence without changing the account.
original_method: Retain one GET to the source-exact account-member path after resolving `account_instance` from an approved source, replacing embedded credentials and TLS bypass with trusted, secret-safe access.
manual_activity: The security/BMC owner authorizes the exact account instance and approved fields, supplies least-privilege credentials and certificate trust, and defines redaction for usernames, identifiers, roles and OEM properties.
required_inputs: BMC endpoint bound to immutable SUT identity
Authorized account member link or exact instance ID
safety_requirements: Do not expose credentials or Authorization
Do not guess or enumerate account IDs
Redact account identity and role data as approved
No password, role, enabled-state, lockout or account mutation
agent_execution_scope: Bind endpoint and certificate to intended BMC
Validate ManagerAccount schema and @odata.id exact match
Export redacted evidence and audit no mutation
engineer_actions: Authorize the exact account instance and access scope
Approve certificate trust and field-level redaction

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The command addresses the intended member path but its escaped ACC_ID form needs correct runtime substitution; `-k`, basic-auth argv and full JSON output are unsafe, and it lacks authorization, schema and exact @odata.id checks.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: With approved certificate trust and secret-safe least-privilege authentication, GET exactly the authorized /redfish/v1/AccountService/Accounts/<account-instance>, require HTTP/JSON/ManagerAccount schema and exact @odata.id match, then export only approved redacted fields.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The member GET intent and 15/10 timing remain; no instance ID, expected username, role or enabled state is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve the member from an approved collection/inventory, verify trusted transport and exact resource identity, validate the ManagerAccount schema, and retain a redacted field-level result.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authorization, trust, identity/schema validation and disclosure control instead of accepting readable full JSON.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The preceding collection proves membership topology but not this member's approved identity, role, enabled state or schema; this case does not prove collection completeness.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Even a read-only account response may disclose usernames, role topology, lockout state or OEM security fields, and a numeric ID alone is not sufficient authorization.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish SDK or session token is equivalent only if it preserves certificate binding, exact authorized member selection, least privilege, identical @odata.id/schema checks and field-level redaction.
expected_evidence: Immutable BMC endpoint and certificate/trust result
Authorized source for the exact member link/ID
Credential-provider and parser/schema versions without secrets
HTTP status/content type and access-controlled raw response hash
No account, password, role, lockout or log change

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item, member placeholder and GET path consistently describe one ManagerAccount resource, and DeepSeek preserves that intent. The source is insecure and under-specified but not internally contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation and resource type are explicit. Exact member authorization, access, trust, schema and redaction are concrete prerequisites rather than an irreducible blocker.

review_improvement: Makes the account instance an authorized identity, constrains the read to one exact member and turns readable full JSON into schema-validated, field-redacted evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A successful GET of an arbitrary Accounts/<id> URI is not proof that the intended account was tested. The requested @odata.id must equal an authorized collection member or authoritative inventory entry, and the returned resource must satisfy the ManagerAccount schema. Because account metadata can expose usernames, roles and lockout state, raw evidence requires access control and the portable report must be redacted even though the method is GET-only.
